title: ChoiceWithOther 'other' text field rendered but never pinned; no end-to-end POST of an 'other' answer
evidence:
Diff renders the field:
+    ChoiceWithOther(options) ->
+      html.div([], [
+        view_options(q.id, options, qv.prefill),
+        view_text_field(
+          qv,
+          field: "a_" <> q.id <> "_other",
+          label: form_copy.other_text_label,
Grep of form_pages_test.gleam finds `a_relationship_other` NOWHERE (only `name=\"a_relationship\"` at line 322, which is the character ShortTextPair field, a different control). Grep of reference_form_integration_test.gleam for `a_relationship`: NONE — no integration test POSTs a relationship="other" answer.
detail: The landlord `relationship` question is ChoiceWithOther; its reveal text field renders in the all-questions test but no assertion pins `a_relationship_other`, and no integration test exercises the full POST path for an 'other' selection. A regression deleting that view_text_field call would pass every c3 test.
recommended_fix: Add `string.contains(page, "name=\"a_relationship_other\"") |> should.be_true` to form_page_renders_every_question_with_forms_test, and one integration POST of relationship='other' with other-text through handle_answer_post asserting the relationship_other draft key persists.

title: Advisory test gate: PASS
evidence: c3 = form_copy.gleam + form_pages.gleam + form_question_pages.gleam + 5 sql.gleam queries + 5 .sql files. form_copy_test.gleam all_strings() enumerates every pub fn/const (both prefill variants of q_works_at/q_employment_period/q_role) for em-dash + banned-vocab + Art14 pins. form_pages_test.gleam exercises all 10 view functions (landing/form_page/review/not_found/expired/resent/resend_failed/completed/declined/landlord_handling) + all 9 controls across 3 slots + error/back/prefill params. reference_form_integration_test.gleam exercises all 5 queries: get_form_context_by_form_token (direct call line 741 + every GET), stamp_form_opened (landing idempotency test), save_draft_answer (POST+PUT answer tests), remint_form_token + restore_form_token (resend delivered + resend-failed rollback tests). No tautological tests found — all assertions pin rendered testids/hrefs/copy or DB row state, not fixtures echoed back.
detail: P0 100% (all render fns + all 5 SQL queries have happy + core-error coverage). P1 ~95% (validation re-render, 7 token states, CSRF stack, PUT 404/409/400, honeypot/timing silent-drop, resend rollback + delivered). Overall ~95%. One P3 render-pin gap (ChoiceWithOther 'other' field).
recommended_fix: Raise to a stronger PASS by pinning the ChoiceWithOther 'other' field render and adding one integration POST of an 'other' relationship answer. Gate already clears PASS thresholds; this is polish only.
